steps.name: U-03: Hosting Plan — verify Active Plan card shows "Current Plan" (user is on Active)
Wait for selector getByText('Current Plan')
"Current Plan" label should be visible on active plan card getByText('Current Plan')
U-04: Hosting Plan — verify Multi-Group card shows "Upgrade to Multi-Group" CTA (upgrade path available)
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: /(Get|Upgrade to) Multi-Group/i })
Multi-Group Plan CTA should be visible getByRole('button', { name: /(Get|Upgrade to) Multi-Group/i })
U-05: Select Multi-Group Plan → verify "Pay Now" button appears (plan selection registered)
Click getByRole('button', { name: /(Get|Upgrade to) Multi-Group/i })
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay Now', exact: true })
"Pay Now" button should appear after selecting a plan getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay Now', exact: true })
U-06: Checkout — the card on file is offered and only the difference is due today
Wait for load state "domcontentloaded"
Wait for selector getByRole('main').getByText(/^Due today: \$[\d,]+(\.\d{2})?$/)
"Due today: $…" expected on the upgrade checkout getByRole('main').getByText(/^Due today: \$[\d,]+(\.\d{2})?$/)
Due today ($30) should be the difference after credit — above $0 and below $49
Expect "toBeLessThan"
Wait for selector getByRole('main').getByText('This includes credit for the time left on your current plan. After today, $49 a month.', { exact: true })

The credit line should explain the amount and the monthly price after today getByRole('main').getByText('This includes credit for the time left on your current plan. After today, $49 a month.', { exact: true })
Wait for selector getByRole('main').getByText(/ending in 4242$/)
The card on file (ending in 4242) should be offered getByRole('main').getByText(/ending in 4242$/)
Wait for selector getByRole('main').getByRole('button', { name: 'Use a different card', exact: true })
"Use a different card" expected getByRole('main').getByRole('button', { name: 'Use a different card', exact: true })
U-07: Pay with the card on file → payment completes and returns to app
Expect "toBeEnabled" getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay Now', exact: true })
Scroll into view getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay Now', exact: true })
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay Now', exact: true })
Wait for navigation

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('[data-testid="toast"], .chakra-toast, .chakra-alert, .Toastify__toast, [role="status"], [role="alert"]').filter({ hasText: /successfully upgraded to the .*plan/i }).first()
U-08: Plan & Billing — verify Multi-Group Plan ($49) subscription is now active
Navigate to "/user/profile/plan-billing"
Wait for load state "load"
Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'My Subscriptions' })
My Subscriptions section should be visible getByRole('heading', { name: 'My Subscriptions' })
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Change Plan', exact: true })
Change Plan button should be visible getByRole('button', { name: 'Change Plan', exact: true })

Plan & Billing should show the $49 subscription after a successful payment. If the payment succeeded and this is missing, the subscription was not applied to the account — a backend/webhook problem, not a timing one. getByText(/^\$49\s*\/\s*(month|year)$/).first()
U-09: Hosting Plan — verify "Downgrade" CTA + "Current Plan" visible (upgrade confirmed in UI)
Navigate to "/welcome/hosting-plan"
Wait for selector locator('.chakra-spinner')
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Downgrade', exact: true }).first()
Downgrade CTA should be visible getByRole('button', { name: 'Downgrade', exact: true }).first()
Wait for selector getByText('Current Plan')
"Current Plan" label should be visible on active plan card getByText('Current Plan')
U-10: Hosting Plan — verify "Downgrade" CTA visible (Multi-Group is active and downgradeable)
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Downgrade', exact: true }).first()
Downgrade CTA should be visible getByRole('button', { name: 'Downgrade', exact: true }).first()
